FULL TEXT:
University Business School, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Date: 17th June, 2025
WALK-IN-INTERVIEW
The Walk-in-Interviews for appointing Guest Faculty for MBA , MBA (IB), MBA(HR),
MBA(EP) , MBA (BDA) and MBA ( Ex) programmes for the period July to November 2025
will be held on 1st July , 2025 (Tuesday ) from 10.00 am to 1.30 pm in the office of the
Chairperson, University Business School,, Panjab University, Chandigarh:
Qualifications:-
i. M.Sc. (Statistics with Data Analytics) or M.Sc. (Applied Statistic with Data Analytics),
M.Sc. (Computer Science), M.Sc. (Computational Statistics/Mathematics), MBA
(Business Data Analytics), MCA, M.E./ M.Tech. in the disciplines of Computer Science
and Engineering/ Data Analytics, Data Science/ Data Mining/ Information and
Communication Technologies.
ii. Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least 55% marks
(50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point scale
wherever the grading system is followed at the Master’s degree level in the subject of from
an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
iii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by
the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in accordance
with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of
M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time
as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET :
Provided, the candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall
be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the
Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the
requirement of NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or

Business Data Analytics 2

Monday to Saturday Business Computing, Business Statistics, Python,

equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions subject to the fulfillment of the
following conditions:-
a) The Ph.D. degree of the candidate has been awarded in a regular mode;
b) The Ph.D. thesis has been evaluated by at least two external examiners;
c) An open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate has been conducted;
d) The candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D. work, out of
which at least one is in a refereed journal;
e) The candidate has presented at least two papers based on his/her Ph.D work in
conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC / ICSSR/ CSIR or
any similar agency.
The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic
Affairs) of the University concerned.
Note: NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines
for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by
the UGC, like SLET/SET.
iv. Without prejudice to the above, the following conditions may be considered as desirable: -
a) Doctorate Degree (Ph.D.) in relevant field;
b) Teaching research, industrial and/ or professional experience in reputed
organisation;
c) Paper publication in reputed journals, paper presentation at conferences
The applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along-with the duly filled form ( pages 1 to 12) at the time of
the interview. The application form for the Guest faculty post is available at Panjab
University’s official website under employment (Direct recruitment Assistant Professor
Application form (as per UGC Regulation 2018). The direct link for the above said form
is given below:-
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
The above mentioned is on a lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1,500/- per lecture
with a ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that
he/she will not draw any fellowship/Stipend or any financial assistance from any agency until
they teach in this department as a guest faculty. The candidates already availing JRF
Scholarships in the University are not entitled for the honorarium, but they will be issued
experience certificates for the guest faculty.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Chairperson ( UBS)
